All three fixes are in place. Nothing was run (no tests, typecheck, or rendering), per your instructions, so this is unverified.

## What changed

**1. Duplicate closes the sidebar on a narrow screen** — `frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.tsx`

After a successful duplicate that redirects to the copy, the actions panel now closes when the window is narrower than 992px (the app's existing mobile-layout threshold). It closes both the scene panel and the side panel's Info tab. On wider screens the panel stays open, since it sits beside the insight there.

**2. Back link on the transfer page** — `frontend/src/scenes/resource-transfer/resourceTransferLogic.ts`, `ResourceTransfer.tsx`

The transfer page only has the numeric ID in its URL, and it was passing that to the short-ID insight link. The page now fetches the insight by numeric ID on load to get its short ID, and Back uses the standard insight link with it. Dashboard and survey Back links are unchanged.

**3. Subscriptions empty-state card** — `products/subscriptions/frontend/components/Subscriptions/views/SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`

The featured card is now a container-query container. Below 28rem of card width the illustration stacks above the text; at or above that it sits beside the text as before.

**Test** — `frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.test.ts`

I added one parameterized case to the existing `duplicateInsight` block: at 500px the panel closes after duplicating, at 1400px it stays open.

## Things to know

- **Back link before the lookup finishes:** until the short ID resolves, or if the fetch fails, Back goes to the saved insights list.
- **Extra request:** the transfer page makes one more insight fetch on load, for insights only.
- **Narrow threshold gap:** the scene panel also overlays the content whenever the main content area is under 1200px wide, which can happen on windows wider than 992px. In that range the panel still stays open after duplicating.
- **Empty state not rendered:** the 28rem breakpoint is my estimate. It needs a look at a few modal widths in Storybook before merging.
